verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI document at docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json, the same docs site that hosts the Computer Analytics API reference (GET /v2/analytics/computer/usage). However, the evidence does not show that this spec covers Computer's endpoints rather than Perplexity's general Agent API, so its scope for this product is unproven. missing for 10: confirmation that the OpenAPI spec includes Computer/Analytics endpoints, documentation pointing users to the spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of its contents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
`GET /v2/analytics/computer/usage` breaks a dataset down **per member** instead of as a single org total.
